definitions.full: H4263. machmal [ מַחְמָל ] noun [masculine] thing pitied, object of compassion , only construct נַפְשְׁכֶם וּמַחְמַל עיניכם מַחְמַד Ezek 24:21 object of your eyes' desire, and of your soul's compassion .
